top_signals.title: Saudi Business Model Built on Corporate Commuters Challenged by War
top_signals.summary: Soon after Houthi attacks forced Saudi Arabia to shutter its capital’s main airport, one consultant drove for hours to get to Riyadh from Oman. The executive left two weeks later and plans to return soon, this time via Doha, betting that showing up will offer an edge over rivals who’re staying away.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India’s Sitharaman Aims to Keep Up Spending to Sustain Growth
top_signals.summary: India will keep up its spending on roads and bridges to ports to sustain economic growth while maintaining fiscal prudence, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said, as she begins preparations for the next federal budget.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: BTCPay Server warns of hot wallet thefts running on outdated software
top_signals.summary: BTCPay Server urged operators to shut down their servers after receiving reports of unauthorized attackers draining funds from hot wallets.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Euronext Joins Push for Integrated Nordic Capital Markets
top_signals.summary: Stock exchange operator Euronext NV has joined the Nordic Compass alliance, adding Europe’s biggest stock exchange group to a consortium of about three dozen major companies and institutions pushing for closer Nordic integration.

top_signals.title: BCG faces HMRC tax probe in consulting sector crackdown
top_signals.summary: Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is the latest professional services firm to be scrutinised by HMRC over its partnership structure and tax calculations for senior staff. The tax authority is conducting an inquiry into how the consulting group determines whether its partners are technically self-employed or employees for income tax and national insurance contribution (NIC) purposes, [...]

top_signals.title: Japan’s new disaster agency calls on public to prepare for disasters
top_signals.summary: Goshi Hosono, who became the first chief of the agency, noted that there are limits to what the government can do in the event of a massive disaster.
